<module id="asyn_fifo">
    <description>Asynchronous FIFO with configurable depth and width.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="wclk">Write clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rclk">Read clock signal.</input>
        <input id="wrstn">Write reset signal.</input>
        <input id="rrstn">Read reset signal.</input>
        <input id="winc">Write increment signal.</input>
        <input id="rinc">Read increment signal.</input>
        <input id="wdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Write data input.</input>
        <output id="wfull">Write full signal.</output>
        <output id="rempty">Read empty signal.</output>
        <output id="rdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Read data output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter name="WIDTH" value="8"/>
        <parameter name="DEPTH" value="16"/>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <!-- Registers for write and read pointers -->
        <reg id="waddr_bin" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)">Write address register.</reg>
        <reg id="raddr_bin" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)">Read address register.</reg>
        <reg id="wptr" width_description="4">Write pointer in Gray code.</reg>
        <reg id="rptr" width_description="4">Read pointer in Gray code.</reg>
        <reg id="wptr_buff" width_description="4">Buffer for write pointer.</reg>
        <reg id="rptr_buff" width_description="4">Buffer for read pointer.</reg>
        <reg id="ram_mem" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]" depth="DEPTH">RAM memory.</reg>

        <!-- Full and empty flags -->
        <wire id="wfull_flag">Write full flag.</wire>
        <wire id="rempty_flag">Read empty flag.</wire>

        <!-- Logic for write pointer management -->
        <always @(*)>
            if (!wrstn) begin
                waddr_bin <= 0;
                wptr <= 0;
            end else if (winc) begin
                waddr_bin <= (waddr_bin + 1) % DEPTH;
                wptr <= {~wptr[3], wptr[2:0]};
            end
        end

        <!-- Logic for read pointer management -->
        <always @(*)>
            if (!rrstn) begin
                raddr_bin <= 0;
                rptr <= 0;
            end else if (rinc) begin
                raddr_bin <= (raddr_bin + 1) % DEPTH;
                rptr <= {~rptr[3], rptr[2:0]};
            end
        end

        <!-- Buffering for pointer synchronization -->
        <always @(posedge wclk or posedge rrstn)>
            if (!rrstn) begin
                wptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                wptr_buff <= wptr;
            end
        end

        <always @(posedge rclk or posedge wrstn)>
            if (!wrstn) begin
                rptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                rptr_buff <= rptr;
            end
        end

        <!-- Full and empty detection -->
        <assign wfull_flag = (wptr == {~rptr[3], rptr[2:0]} & wptr != 0);
        <assign rempty_flag = (rptr == wptr);

        <!-- Output assignments -->
        <assign wfull = wfull_flag;
        <assign rempty = rempty_flag;

        <assign ram_mem[waddr_bin] = wdata;
        <assign rdata = ram_mem[raddr_bin];
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>The module implements an asynchronous FIFO using a dual-port RAM module and additional logic for managing read and write pointers. The write and read pointers are managed using binary registers and converted to Gray code for synchronization. Full and empty conditions are determined by comparing the pointers.</implementation>
</module>
